<?xml version="1.0" encoding="windows-1250"?>

<!-- 
	SidHUD strings
-->

<string_table>
	<string id="ui_mcm_menu_sidhud">
		<text>SidHUD</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mm_video_hud_sidslide">
		<text>SidHUD nastavení</text>
	</string>



	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_armorbar">
		<text>Armor Condition Bar</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_armorbar_desc">
		<text>Shows the Armor Condition Bar.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_armortext">
		<text>Armor Condition Text</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_armortext_desc">
		<text>Shows the Armor Condition as a percentage in cyan text. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_weaponshow">
		<text>Weapon Condition Bar</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_weaponshow_desc">
		<text>Shows the Weapon Condition Bar.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_weapontext">
		<text>Weapon Condition Text</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_weapontext_desc">
		<text>Shows the Weapon Condition as a percentage in orange text. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_weaponbarhide">
		<text>Hide on Unequip</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_weaponbarhide_desc">
		<text>Makes the Weapon Condition Bar disappear when you unequip. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_ammoshow">
		<text>Total Ammo Counter</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_ammoshow_desc">
		<text>Shows the TOTAL amount of ammo you have for each 3 types available in the inventory.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_oldammoshow">
		<text>Old Ammo</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_oldammoshow_desc">
		<text>Makes the Old Ammo appear where relevant (Such as not having its "good" counterparts)</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_radhealthshow">
		<text>Ukazatel radiace na BHS</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_radhealthshow_desc">
		<text>Nemá smysl ho vypínat.</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_bleedingbarshow">
		<text>Bleeding Bar</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_bleedingbarshow_desc">
		<text>Shows the amount of blood you're losing, on the Stamina Bar, going from left-to-right. </text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_healingbar">
		<text>Health Prediction Bar</text>
	</string>
	<string id="ui_mcm_sidhud_healingbar_desc">
		<text>Enables a subtle bar on the HP Bar that will show the exact amount of healing you will get when using a healing item.</text>
	</string>
	
</string_table>
s: Shows the Armor Condition as a percentage in cyan text. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.
Shows the Weapon Condition as a percentage in orange text. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.
Makes the Weapon Condition Bar disappear when you unequip. \n%c[ui_gray_2]Has no effect if the bar is disabled.
Shows the TOTAL amount of ammo you have for each 3 types available in the inventory.
Makes the Old Ammo appear where relevant (Such as not having its "good" counterparts)
Shows the amount of blood you're losing, on the Stamina Bar, going from left-to-right.
Enables a subtle bar on the HP Bar that will show the exact amount of healing you will get when using a healing item.
